title: Annual service report
subtitle: Arethusa
coverNote: This service was provided on the 17th of April 2026
intro: This annual service report summarizes the general inspection and condition assessment of the Nevron IPTV system on board, together with the work carried out during the visit.
Find a detailed service report on the next page.

body.ul: General inspection of the Nevron IPTV system
Physical inspection of the server, including corrosion and environmental conditions
Verification of MikroTik router and IPMI remote access functionality
Configuration and testing of newly installed equipment
Testing of STBs and system functionality
Conducted a general inspection of the server and surrounding infrastructure. The condition of the server appears unchanged since the previous visit.
Despite previous improvements, it was noted that water still enters the server room under certain conditions.
Verified that the MikroTik router and IPMI remote access are fully operational, with stable connectivity.
A USB hub with an HDMI extension cable was installed and routed from the rear of the server rack to improve access.
An HDMI splitter was installed to enable streaming of DVD player content to the STBs. The setup was tested and confirmed working.
Confirmed overall system stability with no active faults reported.
Verified proper operation of newly installed components and streaming functionality.
Confirmed stable IPMI connectivity and network operation.
Tested STB playback, including DVD streaming and channel display, with no issues detected.
No complaints were reported by the crew during the visit.

body.p: The Nevron IPTV system aboard Arethusa remains stable and fully operational, with no immediate functional issues identified during this visit.

However, environmental exposure continues to pose a long-term risk. While the deterioration of the server has not visibly progressed since the last inspection, the conditions in the server room remain a concern.
It is therefore recommended to plan for server replacement in the coming years to ensure long-term reliability.
Additionally, if desired, we can assist with reviewing and expanding the current channel lineup.
Service provided by Nevron representative: **Anže Tavčar**
Kindly examine the images provided to assess the current status.
